As an Aerospace Technical Data Engineer , you will contribute to the creation, validation, and continuous improvement of technical documentation supporting commercial aircraft maintenance activities. Working in an international environment, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure technical data accuracy, manuals maintenance, and documentation quality across commercial aircraft programs.
In this role, you will play a key role in:
Creating, reviewing, updating, and validating technical documentation and maintenance data packages in line with commercial aircraft regulations.
Authoring and maintaining maintenance documentation based on AMM, Service Bulletins (SB), technical illustrations, user guides, and other aircraft maintenance references.
Performing Technical Request (TR) analysis, evaluating potential maintenance and safety impacts, and providing robust technical justifications for “No Impact” assessments.
Supporting Verification & Validation (V&V) activities to ensure maintenance procedures are technically accurate, compliant, and fit for operational use.
Managing documentation updates in accordance with Client Configuration Management processes, including Pre-SB and Post-SB configurations.
Supporting safety-related documentation activities, monitoring documentation quality, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and performance indicators.
 Your profile:
Minimum 5 years of experience in Aerospace Technical Documentation, Technical Maintenance for Aircrafts Manuals, Maintenance Engineering, or similar activities within commercial aircraft programs.
Strong hands-on experience with maintenance documentation, including AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual), IPC, SRM, Service Bulletins (SB), technical illustrations, and Authoring and/or Proofreading activities.
Experience working with tools and environments such as SAP, AirnavX, TechRequest, DACAS, Skywise, and other World tools.
Solid understanding of aviation maintenance documentation and compliance references, including MPM, MMEL, COC, RFR, maintenance procedures, and Configuration Management principles.
Experience performing technical investigations, impact assessments, safety-related analyses, Technical Request evaluations, and Verification & Validation (V&V) activities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with knowledge of Criticality Matrix methodologies and documentation performance KPIs such as RFT, SDD, PR-RED, OTD and hands-on experience working with technical documentation for commercial aircraft programs such as Airbus, Boeing, or ATR.
 Nice to have:
Experience supporting safety communities, safety impact assessments, and maintenance-related investigations.
Experience creating technical mock-ups, illustrations, and supporting documentation using PDF and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of aerospace industry standards, regulatory requirements, and technical publication processes.
Experience working on Airbus, Boeing, or ATR commercial aircraft programs.
Familiarity with root cause analysis methodologies and maintenance data quality improvement initiatives.
Experience working within global engineering organizations and multicultural environments.
